messages:
mira: heads up — planning to toggle feature flag `adaptive_batcher_v3` to 25% tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. Need a deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback play. Anyone available to run the flip?

alex_kg: I can own the deploy. Will be online for the window. Thinking 30m canary hold, then evaluate. Is 10:00 PT still OK for everyone?

mira: 10:00 PT works. Plan: flip to 25% immediately, hold 30m, then either keep at 25% or roll back depending on health. Safe default is OFF; we only flip the sliced traffic.

jon: quick checklist i'll cover: preflight runbook, wire up dashboards, set temporary alerts for the window, and run the synthetic test suite before/after.

eva: metrics to watch (TL;DR): gen p50/p95 latency, token/sec throughput, per-model error rate, GPU mem/compute utilization, and cache_hit_ratio for the KV cache. Also add retried RPCs and fallback-to-secondary-model counts.

sam_ops: rollback playbook (short):
1) Flip the flag to OFF via flags service (UI or API).
2) If behavior persists, revert the last deploy tag on the dedicated pool.
3) Throttle traffic to hosted fallback if needed.

API rollback example:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/adaptive_batcher_v3" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"status":"off","reason":"auto-rollback"}'
```

mira: adding the config we'll push for the rollout (for records):
```json
{
  "flag": "adaptive_batcher_v3",
  "status": "on",
  "percent": 25,
  "start_time": "2026-03-18T17:00:00Z",
  "health_checks": ["p95_latency<200","errors<0.5%"],
  "slices": ["us-west-2"]
}
```

alex_kg: smoke tests i'll run right after flip:
- `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/health`
- `python infra/tests/smoke_batcher.py --target=canary --runs=50`
- quick quality eval against control prompts (jon, can you queue the eval set?)

jon: yup, i'll queue a 200-prompt eval set and run bert/rouge diffs. i'll post a short summary at +15 and +30.

eva: threshold rules: if errors increase >1% absolute or p95 latency increases >10% relative -> immediate rollback. Also watch cache_hit_ratio drop >5% — that could indicate KV invalidation.

sam_ops: I'll prepare a shortscript to force-off the flag and to run the smoke tests locally. test endpoint for canary verification:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-canary.redwood.ai/internal/test-batcher \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"payload":"hello world","repeat":5}'
```

mira: @deploy-bot please schedule a reminder 10 minutes before the window (9:50 PT) and tag #oncall. Also create a temporary dashboard link in the thread.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled for 2026-03-18T09:50:00-07:00 and will ping #oncall and this thread. Temporary dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/adaptive_batcher_v3-canary

jon: I'll also watch output quality and flag any semantic regression. If quality drops beyond the guardrail i'll call for rollback.

eva: noted. to be explicit: auto-rollback criteria = errors > 1% OR p95_latency +10% OR model_fallback_rate > 2%. manual rollback can happen for any quality regression.

alex_kg: i'm set. i'll post when flip initiated and at +15/+30 with smoke results.

sam_ops: i'll stand by to execute rollback and coordinate with infra if we need to revert node images.

mira: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you can make the window or can cover the task.

alex_kg: :thumbsup:
jon: :thumbsup:
eva: :thumbsup:
sam_ops: :thumbsup:
